decisions.reason: Because the net price display plugin is very close to the firm's existing shop-extension capabilities, the firm can support and refine it with its own R&D and is likely to keep it unless demand proves unexpectedly weak.

The ERP system interface plugin builds directly on the firm's core integration and customization knowledge, making it strategically valuable for multichannel commerce and therefore unlikely to be withdrawn soon.

A price comparison tracking plugin fits the firm's analytics and optimization competences well, but with several similar offerings in the portfolio there is a somewhat higher chance of later consolidation.

This product is close enough to the firm's established knowledge base to be improvable, yet overlap with other price comparison tracking plugins raises the risk that management may streamline the range.
The firm has the absorptive capacity to learn from early client use and improve this plugin, but duplication within a medium-sized product range makes rationalization a realistic possibility.
The net price reporting plugin is adjacent to the firm's existing shop, analytics and extension work, so management would usually keep it on the market while using in-house learning to enhance it.
